installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Redis Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
    mkdir /mnt/server/
fi

cd /mnt/server/

# Keep one copy of the data per Redis version that wrote it: a newer Redis loads older data, but not the other way round.
if [ -f dump.rdb ] || [ -d appendonlydir ]; then
    SRC_VER=""
    [ -f dump.rdb ] && SRC_VER=$(head -c 128 dump.rdb | tr -c ' -~' ' ' | sed -n 's/.*redis-ver *\([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p')
    SRC_VER=${SRC_VER:-unknown}
    if ! ls -d backups/*-redis-"${SRC_VER}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        BACKUP="backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-redis-${SRC_VER}"
        mkdir -p "${BACKUP}"
        [ -f dump.rdb ] && cp -p dump.rdb "${BACKUP}/"
        [ -d appendonlydir ] && cp -rp appendonlydir "${BACKUP}/"
        echo -e "Backed up the data written by Redis ${SRC_VER} to ${BACKUP}. Redis 8 loads it on the next start."
    fi
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/redis.conf ]; then
    if ! curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/database/main/redis/redis-8/redis.conf -o redis.conf; then
        rm -f redis.conf
        echo -e "Failed to download redis.conf"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo -e "Install complete."
